countries.reasoning: Based on recent USGS and industry reports, Russia remains the largest producer of ruthenium largely as a byproduct of nickel and platinum group metals mining. Production is stable with well-documented mining operations.
South Africa produces a large volume of ruthenium as a by-product of platinum mining; data from 2023 mining surveys and USGS are very reliable.
Zimbabwe is a known producer of platinum group metals including ruthenium; data are somewhat recent but less complete than for Russia and South Africa.
Canada has established mining for platinum group metals including ruthenium, primarily out of Sudbury Basin. Production figures are fairly well reported but with some estimates.
The U.S. produces ruthenium mainly from nickel-copper mines in Montana and Idaho. Government and industry data provide good estimates.
